subject: Startups
title: Theranos: The Exit That Never Came
description: A quick win: understand Theranos: The Exit That Never Came.

hook.text: Theranos reached a $9 billion valuation. It planned an IPO.

buildup.text: Elizabeth Holmes promised blood tests from a single finger prick.

discovery.text: The devices produced unreliable results. Theranos secretly ran most tests on standard machines from other companies.

twist.text: No exit was possible once the fraud surfaced. Investors lost everything. Patients received wrong diagnoses.

climax.text: Holmes was convicted of fraud in 2022 and sentenced to 11 years. The valuation went from $9 billion to zero.

punchline.text: Fake it till you make it—unless you never make it.

quiz.question: What ultimately destroyed Theranos's chance of an exit?
options: Its core technology was revealed to be fraudulent
